title: Inspect the account sources before delivery
scenario: Scenario: workflow-map / account sources. Open docs/map/workflow.html locally. This guide explains the source inventory; no installer or active account configuration is supplied.

steps.title: Check ownership and replacement boundaries
steps.instruction: Find Account sources & runtime in the Anytime band, or search for account-source. Open the account-source node and expand How it works and Sources.
steps.caption: The actual account-source dialog with its source guide link.
steps.expected: Follow account/README.md to distinguish shared source from preserved Paseo skills, host plugins and private settings. Reading or importing source activates nothing.

steps.title: Inspect the selected planning runtime
steps.instruction: Close the dialog with Escape. Open planning-hooks in the same Anytime group. Expand How it works and Sources, then follow account/hooks/README.md.
steps.caption: The actual planning-hooks dialog describes the selected source and verification boundary.
steps.expected: The guide identifies runtime files, proposed registrations, prerequisites and isolated checks. Native discovery, event execution and duplicate-route checks remain necessary before any separately authorized account activation.
